Li Hua particularly enjoyed the pasta dish at the restaurant he and Wolfgang visited on May 14, 2026. He described the pasta as "rich and flavorful," indicating that he found it to be a standout part of his dining experience. This suggests that the quality and taste of the food played a significant role in his satisfaction with the restaurant and praises Wolfgang's choice of meal. Their shared enjoyment of the pasta dish helped to reinforce their decision to consider the restaurant as a regular hangout spot for future dinners.

During their conversation, Li Hua also mentioned his appreciation for other aspects of the evening, including the overall "vibe" of the restaurant and his eagerness to return, as reflected in his exclamation, "We gotta go back there sometime!" Wolfgang's reaction, expressing his own pleasure with the steak he had at the restaurant, further solidifies the positive dining experience they shared. The enthusiasm for food and the desire to make the restaurant a recurring spot illustrates their mutual appreciation for great dining and their connection through shared culinary experiences.

In summary, Li Hua's favorite aspect of their dinner experience on May 14, 2026, was the delicious and richly flavored pasta dish, which contributed to his overall enjoyment and desire to visit the restaurant again.
